tagging_basis: AQA 7037 specification codes; AS units mapped to the matching A-level leaf

units.summary: Outline the process of decomposition within the carbon cycle.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 point-marked outline of a single familiar process; recall only.

units.summary: Analyse annual and moving-average rainfall data for two South African stations.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of line graphs including moving averages; data manipulation but no recall.

units.summary: Assess how farming practices affect the carbon budget.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark AO1/AO2 essay; evaluation across stores, flows and scales.

units.summary: Outline how cold ocean currents contribute to aridity.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of one cause of aridity; familiar recall.

units.summary: Analyse the relationship between landscape type and desertification risk in a Tunisian map.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 map and data analysis with anomalies; no recall demanded.

units.summary: Using a photograph and own knowledge, assess whether low precipitation is the key factor behind a desert landscape.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO1=2 AO2=4 short assess applying known pavement formation to an unfamiliar image.

units.summary: Assess whether desertification is entirely due to human-induced climate change.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay with an absolutist statement; weighs human against natural causes.

units.summary: Outline sub-aerial weathering and its role in coastal landscape development.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of a named process; recall.

units.summary: Analyse the relationship between isostatic adjustment and melt day anomaly across Greenland stations.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 map analysis combining two variables; patterns and anomalies.

units.summary: Using a Malta photograph and own knowledge, assess rock type as the main factor in landscape formation.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark short assess with AO2=4 applying erosional landform knowledge to a novel image.

units.summary: With a local coastal case study, assess the predicted impact of climate change on the landscape.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark case-study essay requiring evaluation of predicted change; case study required.

units.summary: Outline the geomorphological process of nivation.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of one periglacial/weathering process; recall.

units.summary: Analyse mean and cumulative mass balance data for selected glaciers.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 interpretation of a complex graph with anomalies; data manipulation.

units.summary: Using a Bolivian tundra photograph, assess temperature variation as the main factor in vegetation development.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark short assess, AO2=4 applying climate-soil-vegetation links to an unfamiliar image.

units.summary: With a non-UK glaciated landscape, assess how management shapes alternative futures.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark case-study essay evaluating management and future scenarios; case study required.

units.summary: Outline the process of liquefaction.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of a single seismic hazard process; recall.

units.summary: Analyse two graphs of global reported disasters and their economic costs.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of two linked graphs; data manipulation, no recall.

units.summary: Using three figures on Hurricane Michael and own knowledge, assess issues in managing the event.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark assess (AO1=4 AO2=5) combining tracks, rainfall and aftermath images with management knowledge.

units.summary: Assess whether offshore seismic activity always presents a greater threat than seismic activity on land.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark to-what-extent evaluation with an absolute claim; weighs tsunami against land impacts.

units.summary: Assess whether storms and wildfires are increasing in frequency and intensity and threatening people more.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay across two hazards with trend evaluation and synoptic climate links.

units.summary: Outline succession in a lithosere.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of a familiar sequence; recall.

units.summary: Analyse maps of the global human footprint and its change from 1993 to 2009.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of two choropleth-style maps; patterns, trends, anomalies.

units.summary: Using three figures and own knowledge, assess the scale of the threat facing the Great Barrier Reef.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark assess (AO1=4 AO2=5) integrating bleaching, pH and temperature data with reef knowledge.

units.summary: Assess the impact of declining biodiversity on a studied terrestrial biome.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark assess requiring a named biome and evaluation of consequences; AO2=5.

units.summary: With a region undergoing ecological change, assess human activity's role in securing sustainability.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark case-study essay evaluating management and sustainability; case study required.
